nodes.description: Finalization must not recreate deleted meeting data; documented write-backs acknowledge with no new writes.

nodes.label: Attempt final write-back
nodes.description: Source: Flow 20 and write-back contracts. Normal delete is blocked during active recording; this covers later post-processing races.

nodes.label: Acknowledge without writes
nodes.description: Source: Flow 20 and write-back contracts. Normal delete is blocked during active recording; this covers later post-processing races.

nodes.label: Active recording exists?
nodes.description: Atomic per-user guard before opening another live session.

branches.then: Reject start with session_conflict; retain existing recording.
Create and pre-warm the ML session.

nodes.label: Resume the connection
nodes.description: Capture continues during transport loss; on reconnect send the last client sequence.

nodes.label: Retained OPFS audio
nodes.description: Only unacknowledged chunks remain available for gap repair.

nodes.label: Read durable gap ranges
nodes.description: Resume reports highest contiguous stored sequence and missing ranges; GET refreshes the plan.

nodes.label: Recording continuity
nodes.description: Durable sequence and gap state. Contract/schema field disagreement is preserved in Data model.

nodes.label: Recoverable gaps remain?
nodes.description: Recover only chunks that still exist in OPFS. Unrecoverable gaps require visible diagnostics.

logic.expression: missing ranges intersect retained OPFS chunks
logic.explanation: A missing range alone is not a recovery guarantee. The local chunks must still exist and pass integrity checks.

branches.then: Trim only confirmed audio; expose any unrecoverable gaps.

nodes.label: Upload retained chunks
nodes.description: Read matching ranges from OPFS and upload multipart chunks with required SHA-256 metadata.

nodes.label: Verify and deduplicate
nodes.description: Deduplicate by meeting, sequence and checksum; reject invalid parts; update missing ranges.

nodes.label: Persist repaired segments
nodes.description: Store or merge recovered frames into sequence-range segment objects.

nodes.label: Confirm durable progress
nodes.description: Advance contiguous acknowledgement only after durable storage.

nodes.label: Trim acknowledged audio
nodes.description: Release only confirmed local chunks; retain remaining gaps for another retry.

nodes.label: Stop microphone capture
nodes.description: Send last_client_sequence and OPFS manifest SHA-256 with StopRecordingCommand.

nodes.label: Persist stop intent
nodes.description: Move active → stopping and commit coordinator/outbox state before asynchronous work.

nodes.label: Stop state and history
nodes.description: Durable state transition, history and outbox. History schema disagreement remains explicit.

nodes.label: Request ML drain
nodes.description: Use WebSocket DrainCommand; REST is the cleanup fallback. Session-terminated Pub/Sub also coordinates drain.

nodes.label: Flush final live segments
nodes.description: Close upstream transcription, flush final segments, then emit StreamDrainedEvent; timeout is handled by stop coordination.

nodes.label: Wait for remaining gaps
nodes.description: RecordingStoppedEvent confirms capture stopped and provides gap ranges and a deadline.

logic.expression: missing ranges remain and gap-upload deadline has not expired

branches.then: Wait for recoverable local audio and report the gap plan.
Attempt composition; record any unrecoverable gap or failure.

nodes.label: Send remaining OPFS chunks
nodes.description: Upload recoverable audio before the gap-upload deadline.

nodes.label: Retained local audio
nodes.description: Chunks remain until GCS confirms receipt.

nodes.label: Compose durable audio
nodes.description: Persist composition manifest; compose groups of at most 32 objects; unavailable chunks remain diagnosable.

nodes.label: Final audio and manifest
nodes.description: Composed audio.webm, generation, audio_version and SHA-256.

nodes.label: Publish finalization job
nodes.description: Only after composition succeeds publish TranscriptionJob through the outbox.

nodes.label: Final audio reference
nodes.description: Durable reference for rebuild and playback.

nodes.label: Run shared finalization
nodes.description: Same pipeline as upload: batch transcript, synthesis and configured task reconciliation.

nodes.label: Expose unresolved gaps
nodes.description: When no local range can be recovered, expose remaining missing audio rather than promising losslessness. Only the confirmed watermark permits trimming.
